name: Document Intelligence System
description: Turn business documents into searchable, actionable information with AI.
problem: Businesses spend hours reviewing documents and manually searching for important information.
built: AI-powered document ingestion, OCR, RAG, structured extraction, and natural-language document search.

name: CRM Automation
description: AI-powered CRM automation that streamlines lead tracking, follow-ups, and pipeline management.
problem: Sales teams spend time manually tracking leads, updating CRM records, and managing follow-ups.
built: AI-driven workflows that connect lead sources with the CRM, automate updates, and trigger intelligent follow-ups.

name: Make.com Business Automation
description: Workflow automation that connects business applications and moves information between systems without repetitive manual work.
problem: Businesses lose time moving data between applications and performing repetitive workflow steps manually.
built: Automated workflows using Make.com to connect business tools, move data, trigger actions, and streamline recurring processes.

name: Automate Enquiries with Zapier
description: Automated enquiry management that turns incoming enquiries into faster, more consistent follow-ups.
problem: New enquiries can sit unattended when teams manually review messages, create records, and initiate follow-ups.
built: Zapier workflows that capture enquiries, route information, update business systems, and trigger faster follow-up actions.

name: AI Document Q&A
description: AI tools that let users ask questions and retrieve relevant information directly from their documents.
problem: Finding specific information inside large documents requires time-consuming manual reading and searching.
built: AI-powered document processing and retrieval that allows users to ask natural-language questions and get contextual answers from their documents.

name: AI Agent Platform with WhatsApp
description: Custom AI agents connected to WhatsApp and business workflows to automate conversations and operational tasks.
problem: Businesses often handle customer conversations and repetitive workflow tasks manually across communication channels.
built: A custom AI agent platform that connects WhatsApp conversations with automated business workflows and actions.

name: AI Invoice Reconciliation
description: AI-powered invoice and receipt matching that reduces manual reconciliation work.
problem: Finance teams spend significant time comparing invoices, receipts, and transaction information manually.
built: AI-powered document processing and matching to identify corresponding invoices and receipts and streamline reconciliation.

name: AI Voice Agent
description: AI voice agents that handle customer conversations, enquiries, and routine business interactions.
problem: Businesses spend time handling repetitive calls and responding to routine customer enquiries manually.
built: Conversational AI voice workflows that understand customer requests, respond naturally, and connect conversations to business processes.
